items.title: Antonelli can clinch the Drivers' title in Austin, but only with a win
items.summary: Formula1.com's race-week preview says Kimi Antonelli can become champion at COTA only by winning. Even then he needs help: Russell would have to finish no higher than ninth and Hamilton no higher than fifth.
items.why_it_matters: The permutation is narrow, so a title celebration is unlikely but live; frame the race around Antonelli's win and the results of Russell and Hamilton. Totals on this site's standings table remain the last official refresh.

items.title: Verstappen arrives on a two-race win streak; upgrades could reshuffle the order
items.summary: Verstappen won the Bahrain GP in Malaysia and the Singapore GP (plus the Singapore Sprint). Formula1.com says McLaren plan further upgrades in Austin after Baku's package, while Mercedes have named no new parts but get a three-practice weekend to understand their Malaysia upgrade.
items.why_it_matters: Pecking order has fluctuated all year; use FP1-FP3 pace and upgrade reports to judge whether Red Bull's momentum holds. Verstappen's title chances are described as very slim.

items.title: Haas confirm Camara for 2027; Racing Bulls left with a vacancy
items.summary: Haas announced F2 championship leader Rafael Camara on a multi-year deal, expected to partner Ollie Bearman in 2027, replacing Esteban Ocon. Formula1.com notes Racing Bulls have yet to confirm either driver for 2027. Haas also run a one-off 'Godzilla Minus Zero' livery in Austin.
items.why_it_matters: Ocon races Austin as a departing driver and Bearman's 2027 seat is described as a formality by Komatsu, not officially confirmed in the source; the Racing Bulls seats are the open market story.
